detailed_description: Nightingale Rose Chart Generator creates an ECharts rose chart from editable category and value rows in the browser. Start from the default data, load a product sample, add or remove rows, edit names and numeric values, or import a simple CSV/TXT file with name and value columns. You can set the chart title, choose a color theme, switch the rose type between area and radius, toggle legend and labels, preview the chart, clear the data, and download the rendered chart as PNG or SVG. It does not provide zoom and pan controls, share links, embed code, custom chart dimensions, or multi-series statistical analysis.
usage_steps: Use the default rows, click Load Sample, or import a simple CSV/TXT file with category names and values.
Edit category names and numeric values directly in the data table.
Add rows or remove rows when you need a different number of slices.
Set the chart title, color theme, rose type, legend visibility, and label visibility.
Preview the ECharts rose chart in the chart panel.
Download the current chart as PNG or SVG when you need an image copy.
usage_examples: Create a product share chart from manually entered product names and values.
Import a two-column CSV of monthly values and download a PNG for a report draft.
Switch between area and radius rose types to compare the visual emphasis.
Turn labels or the legend on and off before exporting an SVG for further editing.
